This looks a lot like #11221, which happens when jax v0.3.13 or older is used with numpy version 1.23.0 or newer. I'd suggest upgrading to the latest JAX version, or if you need to use an earlier JAX version, install numpy 1.22 or older.
Thanks @jakevdp! I'm working on a jax/jaxlib upgrade now but it may take a few days for us to execute. I'll let you know how it goes...
Closing, on the assumption that @jakevdp 's theory is correct. Please reopen if there's still a problem!

timeline.body: This looks a lot like #11221, which happens when jax v0.3.13 or older is used with numpy version 1.23.0 or newer. I'd suggest upgrading to the latest JAX version, or if you need to use an earlier JAX version, install numpy 1.22 or older.
Thanks @jakevdp! I'm working on a jax/jaxlib upgrade now but it may take a few days for us to execute. I'll let you know how it goes...
